# Immutable selected PR412 sources

Only repivot.py, seqenlarge.py, the two re-pivot selections, the PR409 ordered
selection and PR410 enlargement data are executed/imported. Original notices
are preserved verbatim; they also describe files in the full upstream package
that are not copied or executed here. SOURCE-PINS.json records each exact blob
and its original commit/path. The current package NOTICE.md credits the imported
mechanisms. No upstream control-result PASS is used as new admission.
